description: This file defines the RowCellIterator class, which is responsible for iterating over cells within a specific row and column range in a worksheet, utilizing the PhpSpreadsheet library. It provides methods for setting iteration range, moving through cells, and accessing current cells, specifically tailored for row-based iteration.

classes.name: RowCellIterator
classes.description: Iterator class for traversing cells in a specific row and column range within a worksheet.

methods.name: resetStart
methods.description: Sets the starting column for iteration and adjusts the iterator accordingly.

methods.name: resetEnd
methods.description: Sets the ending column for iteration range.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Positions the iterator at a specified column, checking for existence if needed.

methods.name: rewind
methods.description: Resets the iterator to the start column.

methods.name: current
methods.description: Returns the current cell in iteration, creating it if it doesn't exist and mode permits.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Advances the iterator to the next cell, considering existence mode.

methods.name: prev
methods.description: Moves the iterator to the previous cell, considering existence mode.

methods.name: valid
methods.description: Checks if the current position is within the iteration range.

methods.name: getCurrentColumnIndex
methods.description: Returns the index of the current column position.

methods.name: adjustForExistingOnlyRange
methods.description: Adjusts start and end column indices to only include existing cells if mode is active.
